identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of Aflibercept Versus Placebo in Patients With Second-Line Docetaxel for Locally Advanced or Metastatic Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multinational, Randomized, Double-Blind Study Comparing Aflibercept Versus Placebo in Patients Treated With Second-Line Docetaxel After Failure of One Platinum Based Therapy for Locally Advanced or Metastatic Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer

armGroups.label: Aflibercept/Docetaxel
armGroups.description: Participants with Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) were administered Aflibercept immediately followed by Docetaxel every three weeks until disease progression, unacceptable toxicity, or participant's refusal.
interventionNames: Drug: Aflibercept (ziv-aflibercept, AVE0005, VEGF trap, ZALTRAP®)
Drug: Dexamethasone (pre- and post-medication for docetaxel)

armGroups.label: Placebo/Docetaxel
armGroups.description: Participants with Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) were administered Placebo immediately followed by Docetaxel every three weeks until disease progression, unacceptable toxicity, or participant's refusal.
interventionNames: Drug: Dexamethasone (pre- and post-medication for docetaxel)

interventions.name: Aflibercept (ziv-aflibercept, AVE0005, VEGF trap, ZALTRAP®)
interventions.description: 6 mg/kg Aflibercept administered intravenously (IV) over 1 hour once on Day 1, every 3 weeks.

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: Matching placebo to Aflibercept administered intravenously (IV) over 1 hour once on Day 1, every 3 weeks.

interventions.name: Docetaxel (Taxotere®)
interventions.description: 75 mg/m² docetaxel in 250 mL dextrose 5% or NaCl 0.9% administered intravenously (IV) over 1 hour, on Day 1 every 3 weeks.

interventions.name: Dexamethasone (pre- and post-medication for docetaxel)
interventions.description: As a pre- and post-medication for docetaxel, 8 mg dexamethasone was administered orally, the evening before Day 1, on Day 1 (early morning, 1 hour before docetaxel treatment, and evening) and on Day 2 (morning and evening).
